name: Date Mafuyu
source:
The eldest of the Ashina siblings, and a top-selling hostess. Strong-willed and loves glamour. As a child, she was a responsible girl who led her younger siblings, but now she's a self-centered gold digger.

A spendthrift, she's deep in debt and has her eye on the inheritance. She schemes to seduce her younger brother using her seasoned feminine wiles, intending to make him do her bidding.

Can she ever truly reconnect with her younger siblings?

[From [url=https://www.ume.gr.jp/product/ume/shimai_s/shimai_s.html]official site[/url]]
